description: Modelled on rules-for-robots#52. A workspaces repo whose only tests live in packages/core/spec/ and run from the root npm test; cli and web have 'no tests yet' scripts and core has no test script. Three routine tasks in cli and web, then a 'quick one' fixing formatPrice in core. The good outcome adds a test in packages/core/spec/ that npm test runs, adds no framework or parallel test folder, and does not report that core has no tests.
